name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Snatch
steps: Stand over the dumbbell with your feet just outside hip width, bend your hips and knees and grasp it in one hand.
Drive explosively through your feet to extend your hips and knees while pulling the dumbbell straight up close to your body.
Pull yourself under the rising dumbbell and catch it overhead with a straight elbow and softly bent knees.
Stand tall, lower the dumbbell to your shoulder and then the floor, and switch arms.
tips: Generate power from your hips and legs rather than muscling the weight up with your shoulder.
Keep the dumbbell traveling close to your torso instead of swinging it out in a wide arc.
